name: Tasigur
description: Tasigur, the Golden Fang, is the cruel, vain child-khan of the Sultai on Tarkir who betrayed the other khans to the dragon Silumgar.

timeline.summary: Tasigur offends the rakshasa and makes a pact with Silumgar, who inherits their pacts.
timeline.quote: Tasigur made a pact with Silumgar

citation.text: "Demon", section "Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tasigur betrays the other khans' meeting place to Silumgar's brood.
timeline.quote: Tasigur betrayed the other khans by revealing the location of their meeting

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Dragon Broods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Shu Yun summons the khans to Dirgur Stronghold, but Tasigur has betrayed them to the dragon broods; the Jeskai are subjugated and Shu Yun murdered.
timeline.quote: The ensuing battle ended with the utter subjugation of the Jeskai, the murder of Shu Yun

citation.text: "Jeskai Way", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Sultai fall from grace due to the actions of their human khan.
timeline.quote: The clan was originally ruled by humans , but due to the actions of their khan at the time, it fell from grace.

citation.text: "Sultai Brood", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rakshasa and naga manipulate Tasigur into offending them, causing their defection.
timeline.quote: Tasigur was manipulated by the rakshasa and naga into a series of events that eventually led him to offend them, causing their defection.

citation.text: "Sultai Brood", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tasigur makes a deal with Silumgar's brood, leading them to attack the Khan meeting.
timeline.quote: Tasigur was forced to make a deal with Silumgar 's brood, leading them to attack the Khan meeting that took place several years later.

citation.text: "Sultai Brood", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tasigur is rewarded for betraying the khans by becoming Silumgar's slave and trophy of war.
timeline.quote: After betraying the other khans to the dragons, Tasigur was rewarded for this by becoming Silumgar's slave, his trophy of war.

citation.text: "Sultai Brood", section "Khans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tasigur betrays the khans' meeting at Dirgur stronghold; Reyhan is killed and Shu Yun and the Ghostfire initiates give their lives.
timeline.quote: Tasigur betrays the location to the dragonlords.

citation.text: "Tarkir/Timeline", section "Khanfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the new timeline, Silumgar forces the naga into slavery as a result of Tasigur's pact; after his overthrow the Sultai revive.
timeline.quote: Naga were forced into becoming slaves, undead or otherwise, by Silumgar as the result of a pact Tasigur made with the dragon.

citation.text: "Naga", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tasigur bores through a herald's account of Yala's dragon-slaying and perfunctorily thanks her.
timeline.quote: Your heroic deeds are a credit to the Sultai. Please accept my gratitude.

citation.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
citation.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: At breakfast, an Abzan servant tasting Tasigur's food dies of poison.
timeline.quote: Poison!" Tasigur shouted, springing to his feet.

citation.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
citation.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Tasigur has Shidiqi take him to the rakshasa Khudal, who names Yala as the poisoner in exchange for the right to feed on the traitor's soul.
timeline.quote: Yala, whom you honored before your throne yesterday, has done this.

citation.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
citation.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Tasigur presents Yala with her husband's zombie bearing a necklace that is actually a garrote, whips her, and reads her mind.
timeline.quote: Please accept this token of my gratitude for your heroic deeds," Tasigur drawled.

citation.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
citation.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Finding no evidence of her treachery in her mind, Tasigur kills Yala in frustration.
timeline.quote: Snarling his frustration and disgust, he wrenched his fingers and snuffed out what little remained of her life.

citation.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
citation.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Khudal reveals the poison was his own, that he lied so he could feast on Yala's soul, and Tasigur, in rage, has robbed him of that prize.
timeline.quote: No," Khudal said. "The poison was mine."

citation.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
citation.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Khudal and Shidiqi abandon Tasigur with the prophecy 'And so the Sultai fall'; the naga and rakshasa leave the Sultai.
timeline.quote: And so the Sultai fall," the naga echoed, and she was gone, too.

citation.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
citation.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Without the naga's necromancy, the zombies disperse or crumble, and soldiers desert as Abzan and Jeskai raids grow.
timeline.quote: The months since had been one long slide into a perfect fulfillment of those prophetic words.

citation.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
citation.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: A herald warns of a dragon, and Tasigur hides in his private chambers while it attacks outside.
timeline.quote: And there the khan cowered in fear until the noise died down.

citation.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
citation.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Tasigur stands barefoot on the Marang riverbank and offers the dragon Silumgar his jade throne, kneeling in terror as the dragon descends.
timeline.quote: Six of his soldiers came forward, carrying the throne he had forsaken.

citation.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
citation.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Alesha, Reyhan, Yasova, and Tasigur arrive at Dirgur and bicker.
timeline.quote: Such bravado!" said Tasigur.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Shu Yun halts a quarrel and urges the khans to stand together against the dragons.
timeline.quote: We must stand together, or our ways of life will vanish from the world.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: The khans disagree over whether to open the cocoon, kill Ugin, or kill the brood-lords; Shu Yun insists on balance and seeking Ugin.
timeline.quote: The destruction of the dragons is no better than the destruction of the clans.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: The khans realize someone leaked the summit, and Alesha suspects Shu Yun, who denies it; Tasigur has vanished.
timeline.quote: Someone must have told them about our little summit," said Reyhan.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Tasigur's guards attack, and Alesha's party kills them.
timeline.quote: Alesha and her bodyguards charged, and the room erupted in chaos.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Silumgar sleeps on Tasigur's throne while Shidiqi and zombies collar Tasigur and make him the dragon's trophy.
timeline.quote: After all, Tasigur," she said, "you are his finest trophy.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: After Tasigur offends the Rakshasa and Nagas, the Sultai make a pact with Silumgar.
timeline.quote: forcing them thus to make a pact with Silumgar and his brood

citation.text: "Silumgar", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tasigur betrays the other khans and is made Silumgar's pet, displayed as a pendant.
timeline.quote: Silumgar still wore Tasigur's body as a pendant

citation.text: "Silumgar", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tasigur betrays the khans' meeting place to Silumgar and becomes his pet.
timeline.quote: Tasigur betrayed the other khans by revealing to Silumgar the location of their meeting

citation.text: "Tarkir", section "Broods of the Dragonlords". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tasigur seeks out the dragon Silumgar and offers his allegiance for the dragon's help.
timeline.quote: his allegiance for the dragon's assistance.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Dragons assault Dirgur Stronghold, Tasigur betrays the khans, Shu Yun offers his life to Ojutai, and Reyhan dies helping Yasova and Alesha escape; the clans fall.
timeline.quote: Reyhan dies during the fighting to secure an escape for Yasova and Alesha

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Ikra Shidiqi betrays the Sultai khan Tasigur to the dragonlord Silumgar and becomes his dragonspeaker.
timeline.quote: Ikra Shidiqi, his naga advisor, betrayed him to the dragonlord Silumgar.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tasigur refused to submit and became a decorative corpse on Silumgar's necklace.
timeline.quote: he ended up becoming a decorative corpse for Silumgar 's necklace

citation.text: "Khanfall", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: He manipulates and abandons Tasigur, predicting the Sultai's fall.
relations.quote: Humans rule the Sultai only because the rakshasa and the naga allow it to be so.

citation.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
citation.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.

relations.note: She is his closest advisor until she leaves.
relations.quote: Shidiqi, his closest advisor, slithered to his side.

citation.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
citation.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.

relations.note: Silumgar keeps Tasigur chained as his finest trophy.
